backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access control, user approvals, profile management, and community post creation using mixin-based storage.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing product features, associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing human‑written summaries of various frontend source files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme variables and styles including light/dark mode palettes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template loading analytics, setting metadata, and mounting the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the main TanStack Router configuration and route tree for all application pages.
frontend/src/components/admin/PaymentReq: Admin UI card for listing, filtering, and updating manual payment requests with status actions.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Renders an access-denied message with navigation buttons for restricted admin-only areas.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Displays a modal form for creating or updating a user profile and submits the data via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/billing/ManualUp: Provides a dialog for users to submit UPI payment proof with transaction ID and optional screenshot upload.
frontend/src/components/common/BackToTop: Shows a floating button that appears on scroll and smoothly scrolls the page back to the top.
frontend/src/components/community/Commun: Displays a community post with author info, timestamp, content, and tags in a styled card.
frontend/src/components/community/Create: Modal dialog for creating community posts with caption, title, post type, and optional image attachment.
frontend/src/components/createStudio/Des: Full-screen panel for editing design customizations such as template, style, fonts, colors, and emojis.
frontend/src/components/createStudio/edi: Defines preset options for templates, styles, textures, fonts, colors, borders, and default emojis used in the design editor.
frontend/src/components/createStudio/typ: Defines TypeScript interfaces for design previews, customizations, editor presets, and style-related options.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main app layout with navbar, footer, theming, and syncs user plan data into state.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders the site footer with navigation links, company info, and social/media references.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Navba: Implements the main navigation bar with links, login/signup handling, and a mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Profi: Shows a user profile dropdown with account links and logout functionality.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Exports static marketing copy for the home page, pricing page, and creator onboarding.
frontend/src/content/faqs.ts: Defines FAQ entries and their TypeScript interface for use across the site.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommunityPosts.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all or following community posts and creating new posts, with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth state, including login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: Hook that updates document title and meta/OG tags based on provided options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, approvals, roles, and various backend actor actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode styles, utilities, and global layout rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point mounting React with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard showing approval management and stats, restricted to admin users.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Billing UI for managing plans and initiating UPI payments with identity checks and status handling.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Renders a blog listing page with static posts, using cards to display title, metadata, and a preview excerpt.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityPage.tsx: Implements a community feed with tabs for all posts or followed creators, loading states, and a dialog for creating posts.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Displays contact options including email support, live chat, and various inquiry addresses, with navigation to a support page.
frontend/src/pages/CreateStudioPage.tsx: Provides an AI design studio for generating, editing, and downloading custom card designs with user-provided inputs.
frontend/src/pages/CreatorProfilePage.ts: Shows a creator’s profile with stats, bio, actions, and a tabbed portfolio or reviews section.
frontend/src/pages/CreatorsPage.tsx: Lists multiple creators with basic stats and buttons to view profiles or follow them.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the user dashboard with authentication checks, profile greeting, plan badge, and navigation cards for creating designs, viewing usage, and managing billing. Shows a login prompt if the user is not authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/FaqPage.tsx: Displays a FAQ list using an accordion, pulling question–answer content from a shared data file. Sets meta tags for the FAQ page.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Implements the marketing homepage with hero content, demo input preview, feature sections, and navigation CTAs. Updates page metadata and manages simple state for the demo preview.
frontend/src/pages/LegalPrivacyPage.tsx: Shows the platform’s privacy policy using card components, detailing data collection, usage, rights, and security practices. Sets appropriate page metadata.
frontend/src/pages/LegalRefundPage.tsx: Presents the refund policy including money‑back guarantee terms, eligibility rules, refund request steps, and marketplace refund guidelines. Includes page meta configuration.
frontend/src/pages/LegalTermsPage.tsx: Defines the Terms of Service page outlining user obligations, permitted and prohibited activities, IP rights, payments, and liability limits. Uses card-based sections and sets relevant metadata.
frontend/src/pages/MarketplacePage.tsx: Marketplace page showing premium templates, upgrade prompts for free users, and search/filter UI.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: 404 page displaying error message with links to home and marketplace.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Pricing page with plan comparison, monthly/yearly toggle, and upgrade navigation handling.
frontend/src/pages/PublishPage.tsx: Template publishing form requiring login, with fields for details, type, and optional price.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: Support center page offering contact options and a ticket submission form with validation.
frontend/src/pages/TemplatesPage.tsx: Template gallery displaying mock templates that navigate to the create page when selected.
frontend/src/state/planStore.ts: Zustand store managing user plan tier and billing period with helpers for feature access checks.
frontend/src/utils/designPreview.ts: Generates deterministic SVG-based design previews and applies template/custom color variants using occasion-driven color palettes.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routes), store/retrieve them in sessionStorage, and manage persistent URL-driven state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with extended color variables, container settings, animations, and utilities for a custom themed UI.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current version, feature set, architectural notes, and outstanding issues for WishMint AI.
